findings.evidence: `Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Quotient/Operations.lean:484` `@[simp] theorem Quotient.liftₐ_apply ... = Ideal.Quotient.lift I (f : A →+* B) hI x := rfl`; `liftₐ` itself is defined at line 469 under `set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false`, i.e. this defeq is deliberately fragile.
findings.fix: Use the explicit lemma: `by simp [kernelPointConnectedComponentAlgHom, Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ_apply]` (then `Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk` fires).
findings.issue: `unfold kernelPointConnectedComponentAlgHom; exact Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk _ _ _` closes an `AlgHom` application goal with the `RingHom` `lift` lemma, relying on `liftₐ` unfolding to `Ideal.Quotient.lift` across the bundled-hom wrapper.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Topology/Homeomorph/Lemmas.lean:178-179` `def setCongr {s t} (h : s = t) : s ≃ₜ t where toEquiv := Equiv.setCongr h`; `Mathlib/Topology/Homeomorph/Defs.lean:96` `theorem coe_toEquiv (h : X ≃ₜ Y) : ⇑h.toEquiv = h`.
findings.fix: Drop the `rw`/`change`/`rw` script and prove it by `rfl` (or `Subtype.ext rfl`) — every constituent (`Homeomorph.trans`, `IsEmbedding.toHomeomorph`, `Equiv.setCongr`) is a structure literal whose `val` is `comap (mk _) y`; if the wrapper must be crossed explicitly, use `Homeomorph.coe_toEquiv`.
findings.issue: `primeSpectrumQuotientHomeomorphConnectedComponent_apply` restates the entire goal term in a six-line `change` to swap `Homeomorph.setCongr` for `Equiv.setCongr`; the comment's claim that no application lemma exists is wrong, and the step depends on `Homeomorph.setCongr` unfolding to its `toEquiv` field.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Data/SetLike/Basic.lean:179` `theorem mem_coe {x : B} : x ∈ (p : Set B) ↔ x ∈ p`; `Opens` is `SetLike`, and `PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen` is at `Mathlib/RingTheory/Spectrum/Prime/Topology.lean:514`.
findings.fix: Replace with `rw [← mem_basicOpen, ← SetLike.mem_coe, basicOpen_connectedComponentIdempotent]; exact mem_connectedComponent`.
findings.issue: `connectedComponentIdempotent_notMem` uses `change x ∈ (basicOpen _ : Set _)` to convert `Opens` membership into set membership; the goal is reachable by the explicit coercion lemma.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Topology/Sets/Closeds.lean:332` `@[simps] def toOpens (s : Clopens α) : Opens α := ⟨s, s.isOpen⟩`, so a coe simp lemma is generated; the upstream statement `basicOpen_isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm` (`Mathlib/RingTheory/Spectrum/Prime/Topology.lean:1409`) is an `Opens` equality.
findings.fix: Use the `@[simps]`-generated coercion lemma for `Clopens.toOpens` (together with `Opens.coe_mk`) instead of listing the definition name; the rest of the `simpa only` can then stay.
findings.issue: `basicOpen_connectedComponentIdempotent` closes the goal by `simpa only` with the *definition* `TopologicalSpace.Clopens.toOpens` in the simp set, i.e. unfolding the wrapper to make the coercions line up — brittle if the definition changes shape.

summary: Four proofs cross wrapper/coercion boundaries by definitional unfolding (two goal-restating `change`s, one `unfold`, one def-unfolding `simpa only`) where Mathlib already supplies the explicit lemma. Replace each with the named lemma.
